name: Crossing-based selection
summary: Targets are selected by sweeping the ray or cursor across their boundary instead of pointing at them and clicking.
howItWorks: The user moves a ray or virtual hand so that it crosses the target's edge; the crossing itself confirms the selection, avoiding the hand jitter caused by a button press.
